technical.summary: Mixed signals with intermediate-term bullish structure (EMA/SMA 20/50/200) undermined by short-term weakness (death cross, price below key EMAs, stoch bearish cross), low ADX trend strength, and no confirmed entry trigger.

fundamental.summary: ABBV shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 91 days—insufficient smart money alignment for actionable trade.

sentiment.summary: Mixed signals: modest congressional purchases (small amounts, non-senior members) lack conviction; market fear (42 Fear & Greed, 40% bearish) presents contrarian opportunity, but absence of recent news data and neutral AAII sentiment prevent confirmation.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (335 reading) with flat yield curve and recent FOMC event create severely unfavourable macro backdrop; earnings in 91 days poses moderate binary risk but secondary to acute volatility environment.

debate.key_bull_argument: Intermediate-term EMA/SMA structure (20/50/200 bullish) with supertrend signal and price near support (128.08) offers contrarian entry in fear-driven market (42 Fear & Greed).
debate.key_bear_argument: Short-term death cross, price below EMA-9/21, stochastic bearish cross, zero ADX trend strength, VIX crisis regime (335), high earnings risk, and weak fundamental/sentiment alignment create compounding headwinds that overwhelm intermediate bullish structure.

decision.entry_rationale: While intermediate EMA/SMA structure (20/50/200) is bullish and price sits at support (128.08), the confluence of short-term death cross, stochastic bearish cross, zero ADX trend strength, and VIX crisis regime (335) creates unacceptable risk/reward asymmetry for swing trade entry.
decision.primary_risk: VIX crisis environment (335) combined with 91-day earnings binary event and weak short-term technicals (death cross, price below EMA-9/21) creates elevated whipsaw risk that negates support-level entry advantage.
